summary: Bundled SDK with pattern-match hits on POST calls and a 'dyndns' string
details: @magda/semantic-indexer-sdk ships a minified bundle (dist/index.js) that contains multiple HTTP POST call sites and a literal 'dyndns' substring. These are keyword co-occurrences typical of a bundled SDK: HTTP client code performing configurable POST requests against caller/config-supplied endpoints, and a 'dyndns' token likely originating from an embedded library or documentation string rather than a hardcoded C2 destination. No specific installer-side secret is read and exfiltrated to a hardcoded attacker-controlled host, no lifecycle scripts fetch or execute remote code, no credential-store or wallet/browser enumeration path is present, and no import/require-time side effect posts installer data off-host. The package presents as an SDK for the Magda data catalog project consistent with its scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
